title: Sunday · the Rain, 2017
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Twentieth January. The motel lobby's glass door in rain, from the desk. The hum line under all three tiers.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the motel's glass door from the night desk, 3 AM, rain on the glass, the lot's one sodium light. The hum line beneath.

image.prompt: a motel lobby's glass door seen from the night desk at 3 AM with rain streaking it and one sodium light in the lot beyond, wet-on-wet watercolor, a flat line beneath the tier, no words

panels.name: Glass

panels.composition: Tier 2: the desk. The bell. The pad. A hand drawing. The hum line.

image.prompt: a motel desk at night with a bell and a pad, a man's hand drawing, a flat line beneath, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Desk

panels.composition: Tier 3: the door, dawn, the rain thinning, the sodium light off, the sky gray-green. A man in a polo going out through it. The hum line ends at the door.

image.prompt: a motel's glass door at dawn with the rain thinning and a man in a maroon polo going out through it, the flat line beneath the tier stopping at the door, watercolor, no words
image.notes: The hum line stops where the door is. The only tier where it ends.

panels.name: Out

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: The Rain at the motel. The hum stops at the door.
